prompt: The baker in Vienna refused (to share) her secret apple cake recipe.
explanation_ru: После глагола refuse (отказываться) всегда используется инфинитив с частицей to: refused to share.

prompt: Our pizza driver admitted (to eat) one warm slice from the box.
explanation_ru: Глагол admit (признавать) требует после себя форму на -ing (или having + V3 для подчёркивания предшествования): admitted eating.

prompt: Thabo promised (to learn) the café cash system quickly and smiled.
explanation_ru: После глагола promise (обещать) ставится инфинитив с to: promised to learn.

prompt: Why did the Paris ticket clerk refuse (to accept) your torn ticket?
explanation_ru: После глагола refuse в любом типе предложения, включая вопрос, используется инфинитив с to: refuse to accept.

prompt: At dinner, my aunt advised me (to save) part of my first pay.
explanation_ru: Когда после advise указано дополнение (кому советуют), используется модель advise + someone + to-инфинитив: advised me to save.

prompt: Backstage in Berlin, the singer admitted ___ half the words during the show.
explanation_ru: После глагола admit требуется форма на -ing (admitted forgetting). Типичная ошибка — ставить инфинитив с to или лишний предлог.

prompt: Mikkel refused ___ for the broken toy because we had no receipt.
explanation_ru: После глагола refuse нужен инфинитив с частицей to (refused to pay). Использовать -ing или придаточное с that после refuse нельзя.

prompt: A local customer suggested to try the mild sauce instead of the hot one.
answer: A local customer suggested trying the mild sauce instead of the hot one.
accepted_answers: A local customer suggested trying the mild sauce instead of the hot one.
explanation_ru: После глагола suggest нельзя ставить инфинитив с to — это частая ошибка. Правильная модель без указания лица — suggest + -ing: suggested trying.

prompt: At a Prague theatre, the cashier says, "I cannot sell these front seats."
options: The cashier agreed to sell us the front seats.
The cashier refused selling us the front seats.
The cashier refused to sell us the front seats.
The cashier promised to sell us the front seats.
explanation_ru: Отказ передаётся глаголом refuse по схеме refuse + to-инфинитив: refused to sell. Форма refused selling грамматически неверна, а agreed и promised искажают смысл.

prompt: In Guangzhou, the boy said, "I touched the net." → He admitted …
accepted_answers: He admitted having touched the net.
He admitted that he had touched the net.
He admitted he had touched the net.
He admitted that he touched the net.
He admitted he touched the net.
explanation_ru: Признание в поступке передаётся через admit + -ing (или admit that + придаточное со сдвигом времени): He admitted touching the net.

prompt: Feeling embarrassed, the hotel worker in Mexico City apologised (to move) my heavy suitcase to the wrong floor.
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise требует предлога for и формы на -ing: apologised for moving. Ставить после него инфинитив с to нельзя.

prompt: Before the New York comedy show, the host warned me (not / to start) with that old joke because everyone knew it.
explanation_ru: Предупреждение о том, чего не следует делать, строится по схеме warn + someone + not to + глагол: warned me not to start. Частица not всегда стоит перед to.

prompt: When I bought a phone in Kuala Lumpur, Mr Lim warned me (not / to use) my old charger with it.
explanation_ru: После warn + дополнение отрицательный инфинитив образуется с not перед частицей to: warned me not to use.

prompt: Did Diego really deny (to paint) that tiny blue door on the square wall, or did he finally admit (to do) it?
explanation_ru: Оба глагола — deny (отрицать) и admit (признавать) — требуют после себя форму на -ing (или having + V3): deny painting, admit doing.

prompt: During the live radio call from Iceland, the weather expert insisted (to check) the latest maps before naming a time.
explanation_ru: Глагол insist (настаивать) употребляется с предлогом on и герундием: insisted on checking.

prompt: Raka looked nervous when his older sister walked into the room in Jakarta. At first he denied (to borrow) her phone charger without asking. When she spotted it behind his bed, he apologised (to take) it and promised (to buy) her a new one.
explanation_ru: Каждый глагол речи задаёт свою модель: deny + -ing (borrowing), apologise + for + -ing (for taking) и promise + to-инфинитив (to buy).

prompt: We threw a leaving party for Aroha before her move out of Auckland. While we were chatting, she admitted (she / never / to learn) to swim despite living near the sea. Everyone laughed and offered (to give) her a quick lesson before she left. She thanked us and promised (to join) a swimming club in her new town.
explanation_ru: С подлежащим после admitted строится придаточное в Past Perfect (that she had never learnt), а после offer и promise ставится инфинитив с to (to give, to join).

prompt: Water covered the floor of our greenhouse in Almería early in the morning. Mateo admitted (to leave) the main tap open all night. His manager suggested (to put) a loud timer beside the door. Mateo apologised (to waste) so much water and promised (to check) every tap before going home.
explanation_ru: Глаголы admit и suggest требуют формы на -ing (leaving, putting), apologise — предлога for + -ing (for wasting), а promise — инфинитива с to (to check).

prompt: Our taxi stopped near a busy crossroads in Kampala and the driver turned round with a grin. He honestly admitted (he / to be) completely lost in that part of town. I suggested (to open) the map on my phone, but he waved it away. He offered (to ask) three other drivers and refused (to charge) us for the extra minutes.
explanation_ru: После admitted с подлежащим используется придаточное со сдвигом в Past Simple (that he was), после suggest — герундий (opening), а после offer и refuse — инфинитив с to (to ask, to charge).

prompt: Ms Chen advised the new trainees ___ early in Edmonton because the morning buses were often packed.
explanation_ru: Когда после advise стоит дополнение (the new trainees), нужен инфинитив с to: advised the new trainees to arrive. Герундий с дополнением здесь не сочетается.

prompt: Ghent city officials refused to open the new fountain and insisted ___ the water pump again first.
explanation_ru: После глагола insist нужен предлог on и форма на -ing: insisted on testing. Типичная ошибка — переводить буквально с русского и ставить to test или неверный предлог.

prompt: Halfway through our yoga class in Goa, a beginner admitted eating a huge breakfast and couldn't bend forward.
answer: Halfway through our yoga class in Goa, a beginner admitted eating a huge breakfast and couldn't bend forward.
accepted_answers: Halfway through our yoga class in Goa, a beginner admitted eating a huge breakfast and couldn't bend forward.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: глагол admit верно употреблён с формой на -ing (admitted eating), а вторая часть логично согласована в прошедшем времени.

prompt: Outside the cave in Zimbabwe, the ranger said, "Don't shine torches on the ancient paintings; bright light fades the colours."
options: The ranger warned the hikers to not shine torches on the ancient paintings.
The ranger warned the hikers not to shine torches on the ancient paintings.
The ranger warned the hikers not shining torches on the ancient paintings.
The ranger refused the hikers to shine torches on the ancient paintings.
explanation_ru: Запрет-предупреждение передаётся по модели warn + someone + not to + глагол: warned the hikers not to shine. Порядок to not, форма -ing и глагол refuse здесь ошибочны.

prompt: Although Ciara at first denied (to leave) the farm gate open, she quickly offered (to bring) the sheep back from the lane.
explanation_ru: Глагол deny требует герундия (leaving или having left), тогда как offer всегда сочетается с инфинитивом с частицей to (to bring).

prompt: Nobody accused Gabor (to steal) the leather wallet in Budapest, yet he still insisted (to explain) why he had kept it for an hour before reaching the police.
explanation_ru: Оба глагола требуют своего предлога и формы на -ing: accuse someone of doing something (of stealing) и insist on doing something (on explaining).

prompt: Even though Priya admitted on our Mumbai-London call (the app / still / to crash) on small screens, she refused (to delay) the launch without talking to her team.
explanation_ru: С подлежащим после admitted используется придаточное с that (crashed со сдвигом или crashes, если проблема всё ещё актуальна), а после refused — инфинитив с to (to delay).

prompt: An awkward silence fell over the Montreal exam office when the tired professor cleared his throat. He finally admitted (to lose) an entire pile of our term papers on the train. Before anyone could complain, he apologised (to make) such a careless mistake. Several students threatened (to write) to the dean, so he suggested (to count) our coursework marks instead.
explanation_ru: Выбор формы определяется глаголом речи: admit + -ing (losing), apologise + for + -ing (for making), threaten + to-инфинитив (to write) и suggest + -ing (counting).

prompt: My editor in Edinburgh sounded terribly worried when she called before nine. She apologised (to delete) the final chapter by mistake and admitted (she / to empty) the bin too. For a whole minute I simply sat down and stared at the wall. Then our tech colleague offered (to search) the office backup and insisted (to send) me updates until the file came back.
explanation_ru: Глаголы apologise и insist требуют предлога с герундием (for deleting, on sending), admitted с подлежащим — придаточного в Past Perfect (that she had emptied), а offered — инфинитива с to (to search).

prompt: Silence spread across the Cairo museum workshop when a tiny piece of ancient blue glass hit the bench. Samira immediately admitted (to drop) the piece while cleaning the display case. Nobody accused her (to be) careless, because the shelf had been loose for weeks. She stayed calm, refused (to go) home early, and promised (to repair) the edge before opening day.
explanation_ru: После admit используется герундий (dropping), после accuse someone — предлог of + -ing (of being), а после refuse и promise — инфинитив с частицей to (to go, to repair).

prompt: In a Montreal hospital, the stubborn patient agreed to eat the vegetables, but he insisted ___ the cold soup even when the nurse warmed it up.
explanation_ru: Отрицательный герундий после insist строится с предлогом on и частицей not перед -ing: insisted on not touching. Инфинитив not to touch после insist невозможен.

prompt: Sitting outside the school office, the boy denied to copy his friend's answers, although he admitted leaving his own project at home.
answer: Sitting outside the school office, the boy denied copying his friend's answers, although he admitted leaving his own project at home.
accepted_answers: Sitting outside the school office, the boy denied copying his friend's answers, although he admitted leaving his own project at home.
Sitting outside the school office, the boy denied having copied his friend's answers, although he admitted leaving his own project at home.
explanation_ru: После глагола deny нельзя ставить инфинитив с to — это частая ошибка. Правильно употребить герундий (denied copying) или перфектный герундий (denied having copied).

prompt: After heavy rain ruined the roses in Manchester, my grandmother sighed quietly and apologised to leave the young plants uncovered the night before.
answer: After heavy rain ruined the roses in Manchester, my grandmother sighed quietly and apologised for leaving the young plants uncovered the night before.
accepted_answers: After heavy rain ruined the roses in Manchester, my grandmother sighed quietly and apologised for leaving the young plants uncovered the night before.
After heavy rain ruined the roses in Manchester, my grandmother sighed quietly and apologised for having left the young plants uncovered the night before.
explanation_ru: После глагола apologise не используется инфинитив с to. Нужна конструкция apologise for + -ing: apologised for leaving (или for having left).

prompt: Inside a bank in Accra, Kwame told the older man, "Never share your PIN, even if a caller says they work for the bank." → Kwame warned …
answer: Kwame warned the older man never to share his PIN, even if a caller said they worked for the bank.
accepted_answers: Kwame warned the older man never to share his PIN, even if a caller said they worked for the bank.
Kwame warned the older man not to share his PIN, even if a caller said they worked for the bank.
Kwame warned the older man never to share his PIN even if a caller said they worked for the bank.
Kwame warned the older man not to share his PIN even if a caller said they worked for the bank.
Kwame warned the older man never to share his PIN, even if a caller says they work for the bank.
Kwame warned the older man not to share his PIN, even if a caller says they work for the bank.
Kwame warned the older man never to share his PIN even if a caller says they work for the bank.
Kwame warned the older man not to share his PIN even if a caller says they work for the bank.
explanation_ru: Предупреждение передаётся конструкцией warn + someone + never/not to + глагол (warned the older man never to share), с заменой your на his и согласованием времён в придаточном.
